# GS Machinery

> GS Machinery is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer and supplier of PET bottle making machines (PET blow moulding machines), based in Delhi, India, serving clients across India since 2008.

GS Machinery has manufactured and supplied 1,000+ pet bottle making machines to 1,200+ clients across small water bottling units, large-scale beverage plants, and pharma packaging businesses. The company is proprietor-led by Mr. Sujeet Gupta and delivers machines pan-India, typically within 10 days of order confirmation.

## Company details
- Nature of business: Manufacturer, Supplier
- Year of establishment: 2008
- Location: Kh. No. 10/3, Ground Floor, Near Shani Mandir, Tikri Khurd Village, Delhi - 110040, India
- GST No.: 07AICPG7964K1ZW
- Certification: ISO 9001:2015
- Contact: +91 08045476539
- Working hours: Mon-Sat, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM

## Machine types offered
- Manual machines: for very small businesses or testing
- Semi-automatic machines: for small to mid-size production units
- Fully automatic machines: for large-scale, high-speed production
